content: In Canada, if you experience side effects, contact your doctor for medical advice. Before using this medication, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, to other antibiotics (such as penicillins or cephalosporins), or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. This medication may reduce the effectiveness of live bacterial vaccines, such as the typhoid vaccine. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary. It passes into breast milk in small amounts. Drug interactions can alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. This medication may interfere with certain lab tests, such as urine glucose tests, potentially causing false results. If someone overdoses and has serious symptoms like passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. If you are using this medication for an extended period, lab tests such as complete blood counts, kidney function tests, or blood cultures may be performed. It is important to take each dose of this medication as scheduled. If you miss a dose, consult your doctor or pharmacist immediately for a new dosing schedule. Store this medication in the refrigerator or as directed by your pharmacist. Do not freeze it. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information was last revised in August 2024. It is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individual medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
